Plantillas listas para copiar/usar en ejercicios de cutover, incidentes y cierre operativo.

## Templates disponibles

- `cutover-initial-report-template.md`
- `cutover-initial-report-template.json`
- `incident-log-template.md`
- `drill-results-template.md`
- `post-cutover-closeout-template.md`
- `synology-deploy-evidence-template.md`
